name: AU Online Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Grant
summary: $5,500 grant paid in three instalments for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students in their first year of an AU Online program.
who: Identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, with an Affirmation of Aboriginality Form
Enrolled in an AU Online program of at least two years, in your first academic year at census date
how: Apply via myScholarships on the Student Portal
catches: Applications open twice a year, in Online Term 2 and Online Term 4
